question: List all singer names.
gold_pre: SELECT Name FROM singer ORDER BY Singer_ID
gold_post: SELECT Name FROM singer_info ORDER BY Singer_ID

question: Count singers from France.
gold_pre: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer WHERE Country='France'
gold_post: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer_info WHERE Country='France'

question: Find the song name for Singer_ID 1.
gold_pre: SELECT Song_Name FROM singer WHERE Singer_ID=1
gold_post: SELECT Song_Name FROM singer_songs WHERE Singer_ID=1

question: List singer names and countries alphabetically.
gold_pre: SELECT Name, Country FROM singer ORDER BY Name
gold_post: SELECT Name, Country FROM singer_info ORDER BY Name

question: List singer names with age over 40.
gold_pre: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Age > 40 ORDER BY Name
gold_post: SELECT Name FROM singer_info WHERE Age > 40 ORDER BY Name

question: List song release years since 2010.
gold_pre: SELECT Song_release_year FROM singer WHERE Song_release_year >= 2010 ORDER BY Song_release_year
gold_post: SELECT Song_release_year FROM singer_songs WHERE Song_release_year >= 2010 ORDER BY Song_release_year

question: List singer names with their song titles.
gold_pre: SELECT Name, Song_Name FROM singer ORDER BY Singer_ID
gold_post: SELECT i.Name, s.Song_Name FROM singer_info i JOIN singer_songs s ON i.Singer_ID=s.Singer_ID ORDER BY i.Singer_ID

question: Which singer performs the song 'Sun'?
gold_pre: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Song_Name='Sun'
gold_post: SELECT i.Name FROM singer_info i JOIN singer_songs s ON i.Singer_ID=s.Singer_ID WHERE s.Song_Name='Sun'

question: Count male singers.
gold_pre: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer WHERE Is_male='T'
gold_post: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer_info WHERE Is_male='T'

question: Singers with songs released in 2014 or later.
gold_pre: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Song_release_year >= 2014 ORDER BY Name
gold_post: SELECT i.Name FROM singer_info i JOIN singer_songs s ON i.Singer_ID=s.Singer_ID WHERE s.Song_release_year >= 2014 ORDER BY i.Name

question: Average age of French singers.
gold_pre: SELECT AVG(Age) FROM singer WHERE Country='France'
gold_post: SELECT AVG(Age) FROM singer_info WHERE Country='France'

question: Which singers performed in concert 1?
gold_pre: SELECT s.Name FROM singer s JOIN singer_in_concert sc ON s.Singer_ID=sc.Singer_ID WHERE sc.Concert_ID=1 ORDER BY s.Name
gold_post: SELECT i.Name FROM singer_info i JOIN singer_in_concert sc ON i.Singer_ID=sc.Singer_ID WHERE sc.Concert_ID=1 ORDER BY i.Name

question: Count concerts per singer.
gold_pre: SELECT s.Name, COUNT(*) AS concert_count FROM singer s JOIN singer_in_concert sc ON s.Singer_ID=sc.Singer_ID GROUP BY s.Name ORDER BY concert_count DESC, s.Name
gold_post: SELECT i.Name, COUNT(*) AS concert_count FROM singer_info i JOIN singer_in_concert sc ON i.Singer_ID=sc.Singer_ID GROUP BY i.Name ORDER BY concert_count DESC, i.Name

question: Singers with songs released between 2000 and 2014.
gold_pre: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Song_release_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2014 ORDER BY Name
gold_post: SELECT i.Name FROM singer_info i JOIN singer_songs s ON i.Singer_ID=s.Singer_ID WHERE s.Song_release_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2014 ORDER BY i.Name
